final: SELECT AVG(avg_count), AVG(avg_count - overall_avg) FROM (SELECT trader_type, avg_count, (SELECT AVG(avg_count) FROM (SELECT trader_type, AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM (SELECT linked_translink, trader_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM (SELECT a.translink AS linked_translink, t.tradekind AS trader_type FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON CAST(a.translink AS TEXT) = CAST(r.transreg AS TEXT) JOIN trader AS t ON CAST(r.trdref AS TEXT) = CAST(t.tradereg AS TEXT)) GROUP BY linked_translink, trader_type) GROUP BY trader_type) WHERE avg_count IS NOT NULL) AS overall_avg FROM (SELECT trader_type, AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM (SELECT linked_translink, trader_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM (SELECT a.translink AS linked_translink, t.tradekind AS trader_type FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON CAST(a.translink AS TEXT) = CAST(r.transreg AS TEXT) JOIN trader AS t ON CAST(r.trdref AS TEXT) = CAST(t.tradereg AS TEXT)) GROUP BY linked_translink, trader_type) GROUP BY trader_type) WHERE avg_count > (SELECT AVG(avg_count) FROM (SELECT trader_type, AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM (SELECT linked_translink, trader_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM (SELECT a.translink AS linked_translink, t.tradekind AS trader_type FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON CAST(a.translink AS TEXT) = CAST(r.transreg AS TEXT) JOIN trader AS t ON CAST(r.trdref AS TEXT) = CAST(t.tradereg AS TEXT)) GROUP BY linked_translink, trader_type) GROUP BY trader_type) WHERE avg_count IS NOT NULL))
